notes.title: Update Notes - January 22, 2024
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved speed for actions that were unnecessarily time-consuming:
[list]
[*]Faster card flipping animations.
[*]Increased movement speed for square transitions during exploration.
[*]Improved speed for Combat Rolls.
[*]Clicking the screen during a Combat Roll now instantly selects the roll result.
[*]Other minor action speeds improved.
[/list]
[*]Enhanced Fast Mode for nighttime sequences.
[*]UI size adjustments: Resolved overlapping UI elements on Steam Deck.
[*]Minor optimizations:
[list]
[*]Slightly increased game performance frame rates.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where inputs could be registered before the reward popup appeared after receiving a letter.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - December 24, 2024
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added grown_mushroom to squares during exploration.
  [list]
  [*]Stepping on this square grants you a random mushroom.
  [/list]
[*]Eating the Moonwalk Shroom now makes the character actually move backward.
[*]Minor optimizations:
  [list]
  [*]Slightly increased game performance frame rates.
  [/list]
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where inputs could be registered before the reward popup appeared after receiving a letter.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - December 19, 2024
notes.notes:
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where the frame rate dropped when the UI stacked up due to pop-ups and other elements.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes - December 17, 2024
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a Game Menu Popup.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where NPCs appeared extremely large.
[*]Fixed an issue where restarting the game caused NPCs to persist and freeze the game when interacted with.
[*]Fixed a bug where the character became progressively squished during combat.
[*]Fixed an issue where some users could not launch the game (Visual C++ Redistributable added).
[/list]
